target.title: fix(ci): stabilize terminal lifecycle waits
target.body:
Related: #105705

## What Problem This Solves

Resolves a problem where Control UI pull requests can fail `checks-ui` when terminal lifecycle assertions exceed Vitest's one-second `waitFor` default on the shared 4-vCPU runner.

This blocked #105705 across three exact-head CI attempts even though the changed config-search tests passed and the full UI suite passed on current `main` in Testbox.

## Why This Change Was Made

Terminal lifecycle assertions now share a bounded 10-second polling helper. The helper keeps passing tests immediate, remains below the UI suite's 60-second test timeout, and changes no production behavior.

## User Impact

No user-visible behavior changes. Control UI CI is less sensitive to temporary worker starvation while preserving the same lifecycle assertions.

## Evidence

- Focused Testbox run: `terminal-panel.test.ts`, 8/8 tests passed.
- Full Testbox UI run with `CI=1` and `--maxWorkers=4`: 233 files, 3,695/3,695 tests passed.
- Testbox `pnpm check:changed -- ui/src/components/terminal/terminal-panel.test.ts`: passed.
- Fresh local and branch autoreview with `gpt-5.6-sol` at medium reasoning: clean, 0.98 confidence.
- #105705 exact-head CI attempts 1-3 failed the same six terminal lifecycle waits while its changed config-search test passed.
